title: Nasruddin Tale 184: The Donkey and the Sack of Gold
summary: Nasruddin loaded his donkey with a sack of gold coins and a sack of fresh green clover....
full_text:
Nasruddin loaded his donkey with a sack of gold coins and a sack of fresh green clover.

He asked the animal: "Which sack do you prefer, brother: the one filled with royal gold, or the one filled with clover?"

The donkey buried its nose straight into the clover and munched happily.

Nasruddin nodded in admiration: "A creature of true discernment! He leaves cold bullion to greedy mortals and chooses what genuinely gives life."
moral: Gold is mere heavy stone to those who seek the nourishment of life.
